node.statement: Node 1.2 gives B_{P_2,P_2}=iota_2(B_{P,P}). Applying the preceding theta naturality gives theta(B_{P_2,P_2})=iota_2(theta(B_{P,P})). Moreover every partial sum at B_{P_2,P_2} is block diagonal on M_2(C) direct-sum M_2(C), so its limit preserves the two summands, whereas F(X,Y)=(X+delta Y,0) mixes them when delta>0. Therefore F is not theta(B_{P_2,P_2}), the E/F assignments violate the registered definitions, and they cannot witness failure of amplification naturality.
